violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (container of napkins).PIC relocated container to designated area. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. PIC placed at 3-bay sink to be washed, rinsed and sanitized. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Ground beef (cooked an hour prior to inspection) was observed held at (47-48) degrees Fahrenheit in refrigerator. PIC moved ground beef to freezer to rapidly cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Scoop handles observed in direct contact with cooked or dry ingredients located in cold hold drawer and dry storage area. PIC placed scoop into food/dry ingredient with scoop handle above. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (chloride) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The floors underneath equipment in the storage building and throughout the establishment have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
